title: The status pill keeps the saved status while another is picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  7. Click the part B row.
  8. Click Active under Part Status.
  9. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with a green "Active" pill in the title row.

Step 3:

  • Inactive is selected, and the title row pill still reads "Active" in green.

Step 4:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with a grey "Inactive" pill.

Step 8:

  • Active is selected, and the title row pill still reads "Inactive" in grey.

Step 9:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)
